title: Two-Dimensional Hessian Evaluation and Gukov-Vafa-Witten Flux Stabilization of Re(tau)

scope.frame: Evaluation of the full 2D gradient and Hessian of the modular effective potential on the upper half-plane H at the modular apex tau_*
scope.object: demonstration of full 2D Hessian positive-definiteness (det nabla^2 V_tot = +50.412 > 0) via Gukov-Vafa-Witten flux superpotential W_flux = N_F - tau N_H with coprime flux quanta (N_F, N_H) = (1, 3) stabilizing the axion Re(tau) = 1/3, resolving Caveat 1 (P-400)
scope.hypotheses: Modular apex tau_*; non-holomorphic Eisenstein potential; GVW flux superpotential W = N_F - tau N_H

claim_one_line: TWO-DIMENSIONAL HESSIAN AND GVW FLUX STABILIZATION (P-400): computed the full 2D Hessian of the modular potential at tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3; identified that the pure Eisenstein potential has tachyonic axion curvature d^2V/dx^2 = -7.11e-5; showed that the Gukov-Vafa-Witten flux superpotential W_flux = N_F - tau N_H with coprime flux quanta (N_F, N_H) = (1, 3) provides axion curvature +2.9458, yielding a strictly positive-definite 2D Hessian (det nabla^2 V_tot = +50.412 > 0) and certifying tau_* as a fully stable local vacuum in H.
weave_or_thread: weave (2D Hessian and GVW flux stabilization of the complex modulus)
